canonical_records.source_text: ወጽራኅ፡ ዚአክሙ፡ ኵነኒ፡ ጽርኁ፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ ለክሙ፡ እስመ፡ እምነ፡ መላእክት፡ ይትኃሠሥ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምንዳቤክሙ፡ ወእምኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ አርደእዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ የሀይዱክሙ።

canonical_records.translation_text: And as for your cry[a], cry out, and he will make it appear to you[e][d][c][b]; for all your affliction will be sought out from the angels and from all those who helped those who plundered you.

canonical_records.source_text: ተስፈዉ፡ ወኢትኅድጉ፡ ተስፋክሙ፡ እስመ፡ ትከዉኑ፡ ለክሙ፡ ፍሥሓ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ከመ፡ መላእክተ፡ ሰማይ።

canonical_records.translation_text: What will you have to do? You will not have to hide on the day of the great judgment[a], and you will not be found as sinners[c][b]; and everlasting judgment will be upon you for all the generations of the world.

canonical_records.source_text: ወይእዜኒ፡ ኢትፍርሁ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ሶበ፡ ትሬእይዎሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ይጸንዑ፡ ወይደልዉ፡ ፍኖቶሙ፡ ኢትኩኑ፡ ሱቱፋነ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ አላ፡ ርሐቁ፡ እምግፍዐ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ ለ*ኄራነ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሀለወክሙ፡ ትኩኑ፡ ሱቱፋነ።

canonical_records.translation_text: And now[a], righteous ones, do not fear when you see sinners growing strong and prospering in their ways. Do not become their companions, but keep far from their violence[b]; for you shall be companions of the good ones of heaven.

canonical_records.source_text: ወእስመ፡ ትብሉ፡ *አንትሙ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ኢ*ትኅሥሡ፡ ወኢ*ይጽሐፉ፡ *ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአትነ፡ *ይጽሐፉ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአትክሙ፡ *በኵሉ፡ ዕለት።

canonical_records.translation_text: And because you sinners say[a], ‘We are not sought out[d][c][b], and all our sins are not written down’—all your sins are being written down every day.

canonical_records.source_text: ወይ እዜኒ፡ አነ፡ አርእየክሙ፡ እስመ፡ *ብርሃን፡ ወጽልመት፡ *ዕለት፡ ወሌሊት፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአትክሙ።

canonical_records.translation_text: And when they write all the words truthfully in their languages[a], and neither alter nor omit anything from my words[d][c][b], but write down everything truthfully—all the former things—

canonical_records.source_text: ወእምድኅረ፡ መዋዕል፡ ነሥአ፡ ወልድየ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ለወልዱ፡ ላሜክ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወፀንሰት፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወወለደት፡ ወልደ።

canonical_records.source_text: ወሶቤሃ፡ ተንሥአ፡ እምእዴሃ፡ ለመውለዲት፡ ወከሠተ፡ አፉሁ፡ ተወተናገረ፡ ለ*እግዚአ፡ ጽድቅ።

canonical_records.translation_text: those who[a], from the time they came to be, did not desire the food that is on the earth, but regarded their souls as a passing breath, and kept this, and the Lord tested them greatly, and their spirits were found pure[c][b], so that they might bless his name.

canonical_records.source_text: ወ*ኵሎ፡ በረከቶሙ፡ ነገርኩ፡ በመጻሕፍት፡ ወ*ዐሰዮሙ፡ ለአርእስቲሆሙ፡ *እስመ፡ እሉ፡ ተረክቡ፡ ያፈቅርዎ፡ ለሰማይ፡ እምእስትንፋሶሙ፡ ዘበዓለም፡ ወእንዘ፡ ይትከየዱ፡ እምእኩያን፡ ሰብእ፡ ወሰምዑ፡ እምኀቤሆሙ፡ *ትዕይርተ፡ ወጽርፈተ፡ ወ*ኀሥሡ፡ እንዘ፡ ይባርኩ*ኒ።

canonical_records.translation_text: And I have spoken of all their blessings in the books[a], and he has rewarded them themselves, because these are found to love heaven more than their life[b] in the world; and while they are trodden down by evil men[d], they hear from them abuse and reviling[e] and are put to shame while blessing me[c].

canonical_records.source_text: ወይእዜኒ፡ እጼውዕ፡ መናፍስቲሆሙ፡ ለኄራን፡ *እምትውልድ፡ እንተ፡ ብርሃን፡ ወእዊልጥ፡ ለእለ፡ ተወልዱ፡ በጽልመት፡ እለ፡ በሥጋሆሙ፡ ኢተፈደዩ፡ ክብር፡ ከመ፡ ይደሉ፡ ለሃይማኖቶሙ።

canonical_records.translation_text: And now I will summon the spirits of the good ones from the generation of light, and I will transform those who were born in darkness[c][b][a], who in their flesh were not repaid with honor as their faith deserved.

canonical_records.source_text: ወ*እወፅኦሙ፡ በብሩህ፡ ብርሃን፡ ለእለ፡ አፍቀርዎ፡ ለስምየ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወአነብር፡ *አሐደ፡ አሐደ፡ ውስተ፡ መንበረ፡ ክብር፡ ዚአሁ።

canonical_records.translation_text: And I will bring out into bright light those who loved my holy name[c][b][a], and I will seat each one on the throne of his glory.

canonical_records.source_text: ወ*ይትወሐውሑ፡ በእዝማን፡ ዘ*አልቦ፡ ኍልቈ፡ እስመ፡ ጽድቅ፡ አነኒሁ፡ ለአምላክ፡ እስመ፡ ለመሃይምናን፡ ሃይማኖተ፡ ይሁብ፡ *በማኅደረ፡ ፍናዋተ፡ ርትዕ።

canonical_records.translation_text: And they will shine in times without number[a], for the righteousness belongs to God[f][e][d][c][b]; for he will give faith to the faithful in the dwelling of the paths of uprightness.
